name: pixera-mcp
description: Control a Pixera media server from Claude over the Pixera Native API: timeline transport, cues, screens, project and any other API method.
long_description: pixera-mcp bridges the Pixera Native API (JSON-RPC over TCP) to the Model Context Protocol. It exposes curated tools for timeline transport, cues, screens, project load/save and layer/parameter control, plus a generic pixera_call for any of Pixera's ~250 API methods. Point the Host setting at your Pixera server.

host.title: Pixera server host
host.description: Hostname or IP of the Pixera server. Use 127.0.0.1 only if this bridge runs on the Pixera machine itself.

port.title: Native API TCP port
port.description: Pixera Native API TCP(dl) port (default 1400; set to match Pixera Settings > API).

config_path.title: Config file
config_path.description: Optional path to a pixera-mcp YAML config file (overrides host/port).

web_enabled.title: Enable admin console
web_enabled.description: Serve the admin console (default on 0.0.0.0:8096) for viewing status and repointing the Pixera target.

tools.name: pixera_set_target
tools.description: Repoint the bridge at a different Pixera server.

tools.name: pixera_call
tools.description: Call any Pixera Native API method directly.
